summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the full redemption of two series of its SEC-registered senior notes on their contractual call date of September 11, 2026: USD 500 million floating-rate notes due 2027 and USD 1,250 million fixed-to-floating notes due 2027. Redemption is at par plus accrued interest, with Bank of New York Mellon as paying agent. This is a routine debt redemption under the notes' terms, not a special-situation event. The registrant acts as issuer. No premium, board recommendations, advisors, or strategic implications are involved. Future call decisions will be made on economic and regulatory considerations. No risk-arb angle; this is ordinary debt management.
